messages:
maria: 🚨 Customer [AcmeRetail] reporting embeddings API returned 768-length vectors intermittently; expecting 1024. Error spikes after traffic shift to dedicated pool? Including logs.

samir: which env? hosted/dedicated/private?

maria: mixed: frontend routes to hosted by default but we hit dedicated fallback during high load. Happens only when fallback triggers. eva: reported errors in production around 10:42 PDT.

eva: app got 500s with "embedding_dim_mismatch" and client threw for index writes.

chen: can you paste request id and model alias from logs?

maria: req=abcd1234, model=redwood-embed-large@v2 -> fallback to redwood-embed-small@v1; log snippet:
```
2026-05-04T17:42:10Z route=fallback -> model=redwood-embed-small@v1 cache_hit=false dims=768
2026-05-04T17:42:10Z response_sent req=abcd1234 dims=768
2026-05-04T17:42:10Z client_error write_failed: expected 1024 != 768
```

samir: that suggests router didn't normalize dims when falling back. We should also check batching layer — if batch contains mixed model variants, kernel returns base dims of first model.

leo: infra note: Dedicated pool has heterogeneous model versions due to staggered rollout; autoscaler swapped instances and fallback policy routed to smallest compatible model.

chen: repro steps I ran locally:
1) hit hosted with model pinned 1024
2) simulate capacity loss -> router fallback to dedicated
3) send burst of batched requests (batch_size=16)
4) sometimes response dims flipped to 768 for entire batch

command I used:
```
for i in $(seq 1 200); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large","input":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT'; done
```

samir: likely race between batching assignment and model resolution. Batching picks workers then model resolution happens; if worker reports a different model variant after batch plan, we emit dims of worker.

maria: customer wants timeline and mitigation. They saw 150 failed writes in 3m.

samir: mitigation: 1) add pre-check in router to assert model dims across batch before send; 2) update fallback policy to select variant with matching dims; 3) hotfix to reject mixed-variant batches (cheap stopgap).

chen: I'll open PR to add batch-model-dim-consistency check + unit tests. Also add a metric embedding_dim_mismatch_count.

leo: I'll pin dedicated pool nodes to consistent model variant and roll them more carefully. Also add canary flag to fallback route.

maria: I'll reply to customer with ETA: mitigation in progress, workaround to retry after short backoff. eva: can you apply the temporary client-side check to verify vector length before indexing?

eva: yes will add a guard, thanks. :thumbsup: 

support-bot: Incident created INC-2026-142: embed-dim-mismatch; assigned to samir, priority=P1.

samir: assigning follow-ups: @chen PR, @leo infra pin, @maria customer comms. I'll update thread with postmortem once stable.
